18	    data: { user },

25	    activeStudio = await getActiveStudio()

28	    redirect('/onboarding')

31	  const { studioId, role, plan } = activeStudio
32	  const sevenDaysAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
33	  const oneDayAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()
34	
35	  // Fetch all data sources in parallel
36	  const [
37	    pendingBookingsRes,
38	    consentSubmissionsRes,
39	    waitlistRes,
40	    newClientsRes,
41	    assignmentsRes,
42	    membersRes,
43	    unreadConversationsRes,
44	  ] = await Promise.all([
45	    // 1. Pending bookings — include scheduled_at for urgency
46	    supabase
47	      .from('bookings')
48	      .select('id, created_at, scheduled_at, clients(first_name, last_name)')
49	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
50	      .eq('status', 'pending')
51	      .eq('deposit_paid', false)
52	      .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true })
53	      .limit(50),
54	
55	    // 2. Bookings with consent required but not yet signed (last 7d)
56	    supabase

58	      .select('id, client_id, created_at, scheduled_at, clients(first_name, last_name)')
59	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
60	      .eq('consent_required', true)
61	      .is('consent_signed_at', null)
62	      .gte('created_at', sevenDaysAgo)
63	      .order('scheduled_at', { ascending: true })
64	      .limit(30),
65	
66	    // 3. Waitlist entries (last 24h)
67	    supabase
68	      .from('waitlist_entries')
69	      .select('id, client_id, created_at, clients(first_name, last_name)')
70	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
71	      .eq('status', 'active')
72	      .gte('created_at', oneDayAgo)
73	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
74	      .limit(20),
75	
76	    // 4. New clients (last 7d)
77	    supabase
78	      .from('clients')
79	      .select('id, first_name, last_name, created_at')
80	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
81	      .gte('created_at', sevenDaysAgo)
82	      .is('archived_at', null)
83	      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
84	      .limit(10),
85	
86	    // 5. Inbox assignments — active only (non-archived, non-resolved) with limit.
87	    //    S19 perf: previously pulled every assignment ever, including long-archived.
88	    supabase
89	      .from('inbox_assignments')
90	      .select('item_kind, item_id, assigned_to, snoozed_until, archived_at, resolved_at')
91	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
92	      .is('archived_at', null)
93	      .is('resolved_at', null)
94	      .limit(500),
95	
96	    // 6. Studio members for assignment picker
97	    supabase
98	      .from('studio_members')
99	      .select('user_id, role, profiles(full_name, avatar_url)')
100	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
101	      .is('deactivated_at', null),
102	
103	    // 7. Unread message conversations
104	    supabase
105	      .from('conversations')
106	      .select('id, client_id, display_name, last_message_preview, last_message_at, unread_count, channel')
107	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
108	      .is('archived_at', null)
109	      .gt('unread_count', 0)
110	      .order('last_message_at', { ascending: false })
111	      .limit(50),
112	  ])
113	
114	  // Build assignment map: key = `${kind}-${item_id}`
115	  type AssignmentState = {
116	    assignedTo: string | null
117	    snoozedUntil: string | null
118	    archivedAt: string | null
119	    resolvedAt: string | null
120	  }
121	
122	  const assignmentMap = new Map<string, AssignmentState>()
123	  for (const a of assignmentsRes.data ?? []) {

136	      archivedAt: null,
137	      resolvedAt: null,

139	  }

142	  const items: RichInboxItem[] = []
143	
144	  // Pending bookings (deposit overdue)
145	  for (const booking of pendingBookingsRes.data ?? []) {
146	    const clientRow = Array.isArray(booking.clients) ? booking.clients[0] : booking.clients

148	      ? `${clientRow.first_name}${clientRow.last_name ? ` ${clientRow.last_name}` : ''}`
149	      : 'Client'

151	
152	    items.push({
153	      id: `booking-${booking.id}`,
154	      type: 'deposit' as InboxItemType,
155	      title: 'Deposit pending',
156	      subtitle: clientName,
157	      actionLabel: 'View booking',
158	      actionHref: `/bookings/${booking.id}`,
159	      timestamp: booking.created_at,
160	      scheduledAt: booking.scheduled_at,
161	      ...a,
162	    })
163	  }
164	
165	  // Bookings with unsigned consent forms
166	  for (const booking of consentSubmissionsRes.data ?? []) {
167	    const clientRow = Array.isArray(booking.clients) ? booking.clients[0] : booking.clients
168	    const clientName = clientRow
169	      ? `${clientRow.first_name}${clientRow.last_name ? ` ${clientRow.last_name}` : ''}`
170	      : 'Client'
171	    const a = getAssignment('form', booking.id)
172	
173	    items.push({
174	      id: `consent-${booking.id}`,
175	      type: 'form' as InboxItemType,
176	      title: 'Consent form unsigned',
177	      subtitle: clientName,
178	      actionLabel: 'View booking',
179	      actionHref: `/bookings/${booking.id}`,
180	      timestamp: booking.created_at,
181	      scheduledAt: booking.scheduled_at,
182	      ...a,
183	    })
184	  }
185	
186	  // Waitlist entries
187	  for (const entry of waitlistRes.data ?? []) {
188	    const clientRow = Array.isArray(entry.clients) ? entry.clients[0] : entry.clients
189	    const clientName = clientRow
190	      ? `${clientRow.first_name}${clientRow.last_name ? ` ${clientRow.last_name}` : ''}`
191	      : 'Client'
192	    const a = getAssignment('waitlist', entry.id)
193	
194	    items.push({
195	      id: `waitlist-${entry.id}`,
196	      type: 'waitlist' as InboxItemType,
197	      title: 'New waitlist signup',
198	      subtitle: clientName,
199	      actionLabel: 'View',
200	      actionHref: `/clients/${entry.client_id}`,
201	      timestamp: entry.created_at,
202	      scheduledAt: null,
203	      ...a,
204	    })
205	  }
206	
207	  // New clients
208	  for (const client of newClientsRes.data ?? []) {
209	    const clientName = `${client.first_name}${client.last_name ? ` ${client.last_name}` : ''}`
210	    const a = getAssignment('client', client.id)
211	
212	    items.push({
213	      id: `client-${client.id}`,
214	      type: 'client' as InboxItemType,
215	      title: 'New client',
216	      subtitle: clientName,
217	      actionLabel: 'View',
218	      actionHref: `/clients/${client.id}`,
219	      timestamp: client.created_at,
220	      scheduledAt: null,
221	      ...a,
222	    })
223	  }
224	
225	  // Unread message conversations
226	  for (const conv of unreadConversationsRes.data ?? []) {
227	    const preview = conv.last_message_preview
228	      ? String(conv.last_message_preview).slice(0, 80)
229	      : 'New message'
230	    const clientId = conv.client_id as string | null
231	    const a = clientId ? getAssignment('client', clientId) : {
232	      assignedTo: null,
233	      snoozedUntil: null,
234	      archivedAt: null,
235	      resolvedAt: null,
236	    }
237	
238	    items.push({
239	      id: `conv-${conv.id as string}`,
240	      type: 'unread-message' as InboxItemType,
241	      title: String(conv.display_name ?? 'Message'),
242	      subtitle: preview,
243	      actionLabel: 'Reply',
244	      actionHref: clientId ? `/clients/${clientId}?tab=comms` : '/inbox',
245	      timestamp: conv.last_message_at as string ?? new Date().toISOString(),
246	      scheduledAt: null,
247	      ...a,
248	    })
249	  }
250	
251	  // Sort by timestamp descending
252	  items.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.timestamp).getTime() - new Date(a.timestamp).getTime())
253	
254	  // Build team members list for assignment picker
255	  const members: TeamMember[] = (membersRes.data ?? []).map((m) => {
256	    const profileRow = Array.isArray(m.profiles) ? m.profiles[0] : m.profiles

258	      userId: m.user_id,
259	      name: profileRow?.full_name ?? m.user_id,

262	    }
